nws_alerts.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 18 at 3:49PM MST until November 21 at 11:00AM MST by NWS Salt Lake City UT
nws_alerts.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations between 10 and 20
inches for the Wasatch Mountains with locally higher totals across
the upper Cottonwoods. Total snow accumulations between 4 and 8
inches for the Western Uinta Mountains.

* WHERE...The Wasatch Mountains, and Western Uinta Mountains.

* WHEN...From 11 AM Thursday to 11 AM MST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Winter driving conditions are expected.
